description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest Long-Term Support release, providing improved performance, new language features, enhanced security, and long-term support through November 2028. Upgrading from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 ensures the application benefits from the latest platform improvements and extended support lifecycle.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the eShopOnWeb solution (10 projects) from net8.0 to net10.0. The TargetFramework and package versions are centrally managed in Directory.Packages.props. The upgrade scope includes: updating global.json SDK version from 8.0.x to 10.0.x; updating TargetFramework from net8.0 to net10.0 in Directory.Packages.props; updating all centrally managed NuGet package versions (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, System.* extensions, and third-party packages) to versions compatible with .NET 10; resolving any breaking API changes between .NET 8 and .NET 10; and ensuring all projects build and tests pass after the upgrade.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded eShopOnWeb solution from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0. Updated global.json SDK to 10.0.x, updated TargetFramework and all centrally managed NuGet package versions in Directory.Packages.props, removed redundant/incompatible package references, fixed breaking API changes (SerializationInfo SYSLIB0051, Program class ambiguity in integration tests), and fixed xUnit assertion warnings. All 74 tests pass (44 unit, 3 integration, 12 functional, 15 PublicApi integration). Build is clean with 0 errors.
